svg.text: Campus wi-fi doesn't fail, it hangs, usually in a stairwell four minutes before
class. Vertex gives the network 2.5 seconds, then uses the map already on your
Watch yourself move on a 3D map of campus, and get walked to the best door for your room.
163 buildings, 25 places to eat, and 7 CUE routes across 26 stops.
An independent student project. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by George Mason University.
